single_change: clip finite unscaled gradients to global L2 norm 1.0
nonfinite_policy: original AMP skip and scale reduction
acceptance: all four existing comparison checks must pass separately for each of three seeds

checks.primary: mean per-patient native Dice must exceed baseline
guardrails: mean native IoU must not decrease
mean false-positive volume must not increase
no patient Dice decrease greater than 0.05
checks.if_failed: retain baseline and report negative result
checks.if_passed: candidate for paired three-seed confirmation, not clinical or automatic deployment approval

diagnostic_endpoint: count empty predictions separately; avoiding empty outputs alone does not pass performance gates
